## 223. Forwarders, copies and reading modules (R32)

```text
Result(s): no new result; no kept statement changed
Delta: the twentieth review's B7(a), B8, B9 (remainder), B10, B15 and G3, on main ad2efa757. (1) The connectivity
       measure stops rewarding restatement: a pure forwarder (read off the compiled proof) no longer counts as
       using its target, a law whose instance on the base is recorded (by such a forwarder, the register's
       instances list or a Lean example) is its own class, statements on the base only through a law of their own
       module are a class reported apart, and apart theorems are split into general structure by design and the
       rest. (2) 173 pure forwarders removed, their uses pointed at the law. (3) 61 copies of a statement stated
       elsewhere removed, twelve statements stated once in Becoming.Prelude. (4) 26 reading and small modules folded
       into the module they read as its final section, declarations and names unchanged.
Premises: none added; the commitments of the representation are unchanged.
Output → input: R33 (G6, G7) closes the 172 statements read through their own module's law; R34-R36 build on a
       spine where each statement has one name and a restatement no longer counts as a connection.
```

**What changed in the Lean.** Theorems 11,566 → 11,330, core modules 305 → 279 (with the root), audited declarations 15,857 → 15,621, pure forwarders 220 → 47 (40 of them on the base). The 236 fewer theorems are 173 forwarders, 61 copies and two helpers that only a removed copy used (`MoveFormation.zero_add` and `succ_add`). The kit is [`development/r32-folds/`](../../development/r32-folds). Per item:

- **The measure (B8, G3).** The dump ([THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY-DUMP.lean](../../THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY-DUMP.lean)) reads each theorem's compiled proof and reports the theorem it forwards to, where its whole proof applies one theorem of the run to its own binders, with no witness, closed value or literal among the arguments, possibly through `Iff.mp`, `Iff.mpr` or a `symm`. It also reports the laws a statement gives to the determined-law vocabulary. [THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY.py](../../THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY.py) uses these in two ways. A forwarder on the base records its target's instance and no longer counts as using it. A statement that reaches the base only through `Law.*`, `Assurance.ofMap`, `Assurance.ofPartial` and the fields of the run it makes, applied to a law of its own module, is the class "on the base only through a law of its own module". [THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY §11](../../THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY.md#11-r32-the-measure-stops-rewarding-restatement) documents the change, the baseline on main's tree and the result after R32.
- **Forwarders (B10).** [`fwclass.py`](../../development/r32-folds/fwclass.py) sorts the 226 forwarders the dump finds, six of them generated `_proof_` constants. It keeps a forwarder cited by text that is not re-pointed: the chapter (EN, ZH), OPENING, the generativity chain, other live text, and the RO and Y1 passage maps. It also keeps one whose arguments name a witness, a closed value or an inductive with no parameters outside the base, where the law does not name it. Records, the reference catalogue and the Lean README are re-pointed, so they block nothing. [`table.py`](../../development/r32-folds/table.py) also keeps twelve whose uses go through dot notation (`Listed.tally`, `World.CountsOf.tally`, `Branching.SubProcess.reach`, `Branching.Symmetric.reach`, `Recipe.Advance.leaves`) or need the forwarder's own statement to elaborate (`World.sample_balanced`, `sample_dissipative`, `sample_dependent`, `enclosedQueue_census`, `onceClosedQueue_census`, `Flow.take_le_taken`, `Gathering.unit_off`). [`remove.py`](../../development/r32-folds/remove.py) cuts each declaration with its doc and attributes. It renames the uses with R31's rewriter, a bare name only inside a declaration whose compiled terms use the removed name, which leaves alone a local binder of the same name. The 262 rewrites are logged in `remove.log.tsv`. [`fixes.py`](../../development/r32-folds/fixes.py) makes 26 exact edits where a use's arguments or direction follow the law: arguments the law infers, a projection (`.mp`, `.mpr`, `.symm`), or an argument order.
- **Copies (B9).** [`samestatements.py`](../../development/r32-folds/samestatements.py) groups the theorems whose compiled statements are the same up to the names of bound variables: 69 groups, 145 theorems, 76 beyond one per group. Where one member lies below the others in the import order, the others are removed and point to it (48 copies, through `table.py`). Twelve of the 24 other groups state only the prelude's types. [`b9prelude.py`](../../development/r32-folds/b9prelude.py) states each of these once in `Becoming.Prelude` under one of its names: the one already in the prelude, else a root name, else the earliest in the import order. It removes the 13 others (92 uses rewritten). `Retrodiction` now imports the prelude. Seven kept names keep a module's namespace in the prelude (`ChanceFloors.or_true`, `CrossSituational.mem_singleton`, `Hexagram.and_false_of_true`, `Integers.zero_add`, `Integers.zero_mul`, `SupportGated.sub_pos_of_lt`, `TreeSearch.append_nil`), since none of their group had a root name.
- **Folds (B7(a), B15).** [`fold.py`](../../development/r32-folds/fold.py) appends each module to the module it reads as a final `section`, its doc becoming the section's heading. The folded module's imports join the target's where its closure lacks them, its importers import the target, comments name the target, and the checker's CORE list, scope text and superseded map follow. The 26 folds: `PresentationFrames` into `Presentations`, `CensusWebs` into `Listing`, `MoveRuns` into `MoveFormation`, `CaptureWorlds` into `Capture`, `CountdownCourses` into `Countdown`, `DependenceWebs` into `Units`, `ExchangeFlows` into `Sampling`, `JointPlanFrames` into `Composition`, `LevelWebs` into `Entropy`, `ListedOutcomeFrames` into `Likeness`, `OrderWorlds` into `OrderNormal`, `PassageWorlds` into `OneStep`, `RecurrenceRuns` into `Branching`, `RetrodictionRuns`, `CandidateRuns` and `ReducedRuns` into `Courses`, `RevisionRuns` into `Revision`, `StockTraces` into `Stock`, `TallyWorlds` into `Counting`, `BoundaryFlows` and `BoundaryWorlds` into `Boundaries`, `DiagonalRuns` into `Diagonal` (which now imports `Branching`), `TailRuns` into `Tail` (now importing `Labelled`), `Grains` into `Granularity`, `SupportRecovery` into `RenewalFlow`, and `AcceptanceFrames` into `FrontierFrames` (now importing `Acceptance`). Each was mostly one-line readings, or under 15 theorems with a parent it extends. [`layers32.py`](../../development/r32-folds/layers32.py) regenerates the README tables (278 rows) and the notes in `Becoming.lean`. [`chapter_zh_table.py`](../../development/r32-folds/chapter_zh_table.py) regenerates the Chinese chapter's table. The layers are L0 3, L1 256 and L2 19: 16 name the condition or a valuation, and 3 import one without naming it (`ActiveReading`, `Ranking`, `ScoreRepresentation`). `BoundaryWorlds`, one of R31's four that reached the ethics without naming the condition, is now a section of `Boundaries`, which names it. By `graph.py`, 18 core modules reach `Significance` or `Metaethics` through their imports, 20 before.

**Not done, and why.**
- **Reading modules kept.** These have real content: `Runs`, `CourseWorlds`, `ReferencePlanTraces` and `CouplingTraces` (as the brief judged), `HorizonWebs` (its stopping and continuing schedules), `ContinuingRuns`, `CopyCourses`, `StrengthFlows`, `LastingRuns` and `AttractionRuns` (proofs of their own, not one-liners), and `WeightedTraces` (its own definitions; 24 records cite it). Also kept:
  - U5's general structure on the base (`WitnessRefinementRuns`, `NarrowingRuns`, `HistoryIdealsTraces`, `FrontierWorlds`), which the chapter cites;
  - `SelectionRuns`, which the generativity chain cites;
  - `ContactCourses`, `ListedWebs` and `SensitivityWebs`, which would add an import to their source (`Assurance`, `Identity`, `Propagation`);
  - small modules with a subject of their own (`Irreversibility`, `SummaryFutures`, `ClassifiedBeliefProcesses`, which the dump imports, `ChanceFloors`, `Tower`, `EdgeClosure`, which 73 records cite, and `Renewal`);
  - `SelectionGap` and `SelectionReach`, which would add central imports to `Selection`.
- **Copies left.** Twelve groups whose statement names a definition of the run have no member below the others; one member would need a new import. They are `Closing.Onset.amount_after` and `Frequency.SelfLoop.onset_amount`, the three `sum_one`, `Exposed.holder_after` and `Shuttle.next_off`, `Flow.excess_zero_of_le` and `OneStep.Chain.excess_of_le`, the `nonzero_of_le` pair, `total_steps_shift` and `total_steps_succ`, `total_steps_add` and `total_steps_split`, the `distinct_map_on` pair, the `not_mem_middle` pair, the three `distinct_append`, and the `between_of_mem_steps` pair. Several rest on definition twins (`Distinct`, `steps`, `total`, `excess`, `nonzero`), which are B6's. One group has a periphery member (`Naturals.add_sub_cancel`, `RelationalRenewal.add_sub_self`).
- **Out of scope, noticed.** The twins just named are B6. No census table (B11), witness library (B14) or bisimulation (B4) was touched.

An earlier run, `20261019T225814.056669Z`, passed with the same counts before the docs followed the removals. Since then, 110 names of removed declarations in the modules' docs and 27 in the Lean README and `Becoming.lean`'s notes name the law instead ([`docnames.py`](../../development/r32-folds/docnames.py), [`readme_names.py`](../../development/r32-folds/readme_names.py)). Two section headers that the removed copies had left empty are dropped (Openness, ResponseLearning). - [`sigcheck.py`](../../development/r32-folds/sigcheck.py) compares each declaration's printed type in both receipts against R31's receipt `20261019T213206.644158Z`. The other (`OneStep.Chain.node_injective`) now names the injectivity lemma Lean generates for `Site.node`, which no Signatures step prints. The 173 forwarders and two helpers are absent.
- [`buildall.py`](../../development/r32-folds/buildall.py) compiled every stage in scratch first, with no warning, and stored its steps in the shared cache.
- `verify_ro.py` and the Y1 map's `verify_mapping.py` pass on the receipt.

The connectivity measure on the final tree counts 473 of 11,330 apart (481 of 11,566 on R31's tree under the new measure), 49 of them general structure by design. 172 statements reach the base only through a law of their own module, as before. The removed forwarders' instances are kept as 92 entries of the register's `instances` list ([`instances.py`](../../development/r32-folds/instances.py)). Seven register entries naming removed theorems are retired and three laws took their entries ([`apart.py`](../../development/r32-folds/apart.py)). The table is in [THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY §11](../../THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY.md#11-r32-the-measure-stops-rewarding-restatement).

**History.** The 26 folded modules move to [`lean/history/becoming/Becoming/`](../../../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/history/becoming/Becoming) with their bytes as on main ad2efa757, by `research.py move` ([plan](../../development/r32-folds/history-moves.tsv), receipt `_process/architecture/moves/R32-history.json`, through [`history_move.py`](../../development/r32-folds/history_move.py)).

**Records.** [`rebind.py`](../../development/r32-folds/rebind.py), R31's with R32's tables, reads the moves and removals off the two receipts and checks that the removals are exactly those of the tables. It files each declaration under the file of its module and names the law in place of a removed forwarder, or the kept name in place of a copy. It drops the references to folded files once their declarations are filed, and gives a record whose canonical source was folded the module it was folded into. It then rebinds the proof bindings to the changed Lean files, re-points current references after reading the change, and adds a history note. 253 records change ([`recordcounts.py`](../../development/r32-folds/recordcounts.py) counts the notes). In 210 the proof bindings are rebound to receipt `20261019T231053.882924Z`. In 8 declarations moved with their full names. In 43 the law stands in place of a removed forwarder, and in 34 the kept name in place of a copy. One record (where-a-move-is-formed) drops the two helpers only a removed copy used, and one takes a new canonical source. In 8 records a sentence that named a removed declaration names the kept one; the-split-that-makes-sense's two sentences are re-worded by hand, since its removed forwarder would otherwise read as an instance of itself. A validation scope that lists what an earlier receipt checked keeps the names that receipt checked. Every changed record re-points the files it cites after reading the change, and [`recordnames.py`](../../development/r32-folds/recordnames.py) finds no removed name left outside the history notes and validation scopes.

**Self-review.** No kept statement's type changed, and the receipt and sigcheck check each one. What the removals cost is names: a reader who knew a forwarder's name now finds the law it applied. Records and the register say which law, and where a forwarder was the only record of an instance, the register keeps the instance as data. The folds cost module boundaries. A folded module's laws are a section of the module they read, and the history folder keeps the module as it stood. Under the new measure, removing a forwarder moves no law from "used" to "apart", and apart fell by 8: the seven apart theorems removed and one prelude statement now used. The 172 statements read through their own module's law are the next gap (R33).
